note: Grammar §6d (Captain-ratified 2026-08-03, Option B). SCOPE token `own` retires to `you-control` per CR 109.5 ('you'/'your' = the object's CONTROLLER) + CR 110.2 ('Every permanent has a controller'). `you-own` is ratified separately for ownership (CR 108.3). `owned` was rejected as a one-letter homograph (CDR-09 precedent). Name-only: no member moves, no definition changes. Placement follows §1's slot order [EFFECT]-[OBJECT]-[SCOPE] -- scope goes AFTER the object, which is also how the pre-existing rule:activated-tap-grants-haste-other-creature-you-control reads.

excluded.rule:activation-restricted-to-own-upkeep: §3 RATIFIED table slug (grammar line 232, D-4 DET-owned). Here `own` means WHOSE TURN/PHASE it is ("Activate only during your upkeep"), a fourth sense -- not the controller of an object. Renaming would break §3's exact-phrase enumeration.
excluded.rule:cost-reduction-scales-with-own-coun: §7 stat vocabulary: `own-counters` = counters ON THE SOURCE. Third sense. Logged for a separate §7 ruling (-> `self-counters`), not bundled here.
excluded.rule:pump-scales-with-own-creature-count: `own` sits INSIDE a §7 scaling stat token (`own-creature-count`). Moving it would break §7's closed stat list. Separate §7 ruling.
